name: task-manager
description: Connect Task Manager and deliver selected work safely through ShipTask.

interface.shortDescription: Manage and deliver Task Manager work safely.
interface.longDescription: Connect Codex to Task Manager with OAuth, resolve canonical project, release, and task references, inspect current versions, create or update work safely, and use native comments. The bundled Task Manager skill owns connector mechanics; the bundled ShipTask skill owns delivery intent, lifecycle, Goals, verification, releases, reports, and terminal outcomes.
